name: Weapon Effect Prism
description:
Double-click to #cdye a decoration weapon item's effect# once.

The #cweapon's dyes# will be maintained upon use; only #cnormal and special effects# will be dyed.

Select #cone color from the provided color series# to adjust its #chue, chroma, and brightness#. If it is used multiple times, the item is dyed based on the #coriginal color# of the target effect.

Can only be used on #cuntradable items that are not time-restricted.# Can't be used on #citems that can't use Prisms#.
